observation.command: kill 23722; sleep 3; ps aux | grep "puma" | grep -v grep | grep -c . ; rm -f /workspace/tmp/pids/server.pid; cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root RAILS_ENV=production && nohup bin/rails s -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3001 > /tmp/rails_server_prod2.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 35; tail -5 /tmp/rails_server_prod2.log
